tactics.name: Blazing Onslaught
tactics.card: At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, your opponent must pick 1 non-Faction Terrain terrain feature within their territory to be their hideout. The hideout cannot be removed from the battlefield at any point during the battle.

tiers.name: Master of Arms
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if the same enemy unit had at least 1 damage point allocated to it in 3 different phases this turn.

tiers.name: Break Their Defences
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the enemy hideout.

tiers.name: No Survivors
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more enemy units were destroyed this turn and you control the enemy hideout.

tiers.name: Form a Wall
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units are wholly outside friendly territory, wholly within 6" of friendly territory and within 3" of each other.

tiers.name: Outpost Territory
tiers.text:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective within enemy territory and that objective is contested by:
• At least 1 friendly unit that did not use a Move ability this turn
• At least 1 other friendly unit that charged this turn.

tiers.name: Repel the Attackers
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 3 or more friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield that are not in combat.

tactics.name: Burning for Vengeance
tactics.card: At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, pick an enemy Hero on the battlefield or in reserve to be the fugitive for the rest of the battle.

tiers.name: Search Every Inch
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there is a different friendly unit wholly within each large quarter of the battlefield, those friendly units are more than 9" from the centre of the battlefield, and no more than 1 of those friendly units was set up this turn.

tiers.name: Quick Pursuit
tiers.text:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units that are not in combat and are within 12" of the enemy fugitive.
• There is no enemy fugitive on the battlefield.

tiers.name: Bring Them In
tiers.text:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units in combat with the enemy fugitive.
• There is no enemy fugitive on the battlefield and 3 or more friendly units are contesting the same objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

tiers.name: Daring Rescue
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit that was in combat at the start of the turn was destroyed by a combat attack made by a friendly unit that charged this turn.

tiers.name: Command from the Front
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly Heroes on the battlefield, all friendly Heroes are within 9" of a visible enemy unit and no friendly Heroes were slain this turn.

tiers.name: Hero of Legend
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective wholly outside your territory that you did not control at the start of the turn and a friendly Hero is contesting that objective.

tiers.name: Ambuscade
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more objectives or non-Faction Terrain terrain features that you control, in any combination, are each contested by a different friendly unit that is more than 6" from friendly territory and was not set up this turn.

tiers.name: Surround the Enemy
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units that were not set up this turn are each within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield and wholly outside friendly territory.

tiers.name: Claim What's Yours
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly units within enemy territory than enemy units and there is at least 1 friendly Hero wholly within enemy territory.

tiers.name: Keep the Enemy Close
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that is contested by at least 1 enemy unit.

tiers.name: Feign Weakness
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if more friendly units were destroyed this turn than enemy units.

tiers.name: Execute the Plan
tiers.text: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control each objective within enemy territory.

seasonRules.name: SIMMERING RAGE
seasonRules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
seasonRules.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

seasonRules.name: RAISING THE HEAT
seasonRules.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

seasonRules.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
seasonRules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
seasonRules.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
seasonRules.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

seasonRules.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
seasonRules.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

battleplans.name: Avalanche of Ash
battleplans.twist: The underdog must use Collapsing Pass each battle round.

summary.name: Collapsing Pass
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Every objective is a target; pick one as the focus. Roll a dice per objective, +1 for each unit (either side) contesting it; the focus can be +3 or -3. On 8+ that objective is removed.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent
If 1 or fewer objectives remain: control a non-faction terrain feature in enemy territory
If no objectives remain: control more non-faction terrain features than your opponent

rules.name: COLLAPSING PASS
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick each objective to be the targets. Then, pick 1 of the targets to be the focus.
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each target. Add 1 to the roll for each unit (friendly and enemy) that is contesting it. If the target is the focus, you can add 3 to or subtract 3 from the roll. On a 8+, remove the target from the battlefield.

battleplans.name: Bloodstained Coasts
battleplans.twist: From battle round 2, both players can use Emberstone Cache and Emberstone-Augmented Weapons.

summary.name: Emberstone Cache
summary.when: Once per turn (army), your hero phase
summary.effect: Give a friendly unit contesting an objective you control an emberstone sliver.

summary.name: Emberstone-Augmented Weapons
summary.effect: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has slivers: +1 to hit OR +1 to wound for its combat attacks this turn. Then the underdog removes that unit's slivers; otherwise remove slivers from every friendly unit.

scoring: Round 1 only: control more objectives than your opponent
Round 2 onwards: control an objective your opponent controlled at the start of the turn

rules.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
rules.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

rules.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

battleplans.name: Caverns of Slaughter
battleplans.twist: The underdog can use Shifting Passages; both players can use Navigate the Tunnels.

summary.name: Shifting Passages
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Remove any hidden passage tokens, then give 2 non-faction terrain features a hidden passage token each.

summary.name: Navigate the Tunnels
summary.when: Once per turn (army), your movement phase
summary.effect: A friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature with a token is set up again wholly within 6" of a different token terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
rules.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
rules.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.

battleplans.name: Curse of the Gnaw
battleplans.twist: Instability starts at 1 and goes up by 1 (max 6) each time either player uses Activate Place of Power. After first turn is decided, the underdog can use Echoes of Blight City.

summary.name: Echoes of Blight City
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Pick an objective: every unit (either side) contesting it takes mortal damage equal to the instability level. Then instability resets to 1.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
rules.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

battleplans.name: Escape From the Coast
battleplans.twist: The underdog can use To the Ships! to remove objectives.

summary.name: To the Ships!
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Remove the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective from the battlefield.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: TO THE SHIPS!
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
rules.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

battleplans.name: Hidden Under Ash-Clouds
battleplans.twist: Each battle round the underdog chooses whether the ash-clouds are low-lying (with no underdog, they are). Rolling Ash-Clouds applies while they are.

summary.name: Rolling Ash-Clouds
summary.effect: Nothing can be set up in neutral territory, or end a move there unless it started the move wholly within it. Models, terrain and manifestations more than 3" away are not visible unless a straight line between the bases avoids neutral territory.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
rules.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

battleplans.name: Into the Fire
battleplans.twist: Both armies have Secure the Gateway. The underdog also gets Determined Defenders.

summary.name: Secure the Gateway
summary.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within your own territory, your units' melee weapons get Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while contesting an objective you control.

summary.name: Determined Defenders
summary.effect: +3 control score for your units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: DETERMINED DEFENDERS
rules.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

rules.name: SECURE THE GATEWAY
rules.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

battleplans.name: Power of the Realms
battleplans.twist: Sun Seekers starts as the primary objective; the rest are secondary. The underdog can move the primary with Arcane Charge.

summary.name: Arcane Charge
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Pick a Place of Power you control and draw a line from the primary objective's centre to it: the first secondary objective the line crosses becomes the primary (all others secondary).

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: ARCANE CHARGE
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
rules.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

battleplans.name: Seize the Embers
battleplans.twist: Both players can use Search the Ruin and Back to Base Camp: pick up nuggets on Sun Seekers, bank them on Golden Lions.

summary.name: Search the Ruin
summary.effect: A friendly unit without a nugget contesting a Sun Seekers objective gains an emberstone nugget. If you're the underdog it can then move 6" (not into combat). It can't use Back to Base Camp or Power Through this turn.

summary.name: Back to Base Camp
summary.when: Once per turn (army), end of your turn
summary.effect: A friendly unit with a nugget, not set up this turn, contesting a Golden Lions objective: remove its nugget (this is what scores).

scoring: Round 1 only: control 2 or more objectives
Round 2 onwards: you used Back to Base Camp this turn
Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
rules.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.

battleplans.name: Treacherous Ground
battleplans.twist: All objectives start stable. Both players must use Tread Carefully at the start of round 1; from round 2 the underdog can use Violent Tremor. Only stable objectives score.

summary.name: Tread Carefully
summary.when: Once per battle (army), start of first battle round
summary.effect: Pick an objective in your own territory: it is no longer stable.

summary.name: Violent Tremor
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Pick a pair of objectives: swap which one is stable.

scoring: Control more stable objectives than your opponent

rules.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
rules.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
rules.effect: The target is no longer stable.

rules.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
rules.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

battleplans.name: Warped Ruins
battleplans.twist: Every non-faction terrain feature must be set up within 12" of another. The underdog must use Spreading Warpfire each battle round.

summary.name: Spreading Warpfire
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Set a non-faction terrain feature flaming for the rest of the battle (the first can be any; later ones must be within 12" of a flaming feature). Then D3 mortal damage to every unit (either side) within 6" of any flaming feature.

scoring: Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
rules.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.

battleplans.name: What's Yours is Ours
battleplans.twist: Odd battle rounds: the Golden Lions pair is the coveted pair. Even rounds: the Sun Seekers pair. The underdog can switch it with All the Rage.

summary.name: All the Rage
summary.when: Once per battle round, start of battle round
summary.effect: Pick a pair of objectives: it is the coveted pair for the rest of the battle round instead of the other pair.

scoring: Control the coveted pair of objectives
Control more objectives than your opponent

rules.name: ALL THE RAGE
rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

mapSource: Layouts read from sigdex.io/rules > GHB 2026-27 Battleplans (map geometry: 480x352 = 60x44 inch board, 8 px per inch). Rules text summarised in our own words for team use, 2026-11-02; check the event pack / GW rules for exact wording.

coreAbilities.name: REDEPLOY
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
coreAbilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

coreAbilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
coreAbilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
coreAbilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

coreAbilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
coreAbilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
coreAbilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

coreAbilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
coreAbilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
coreAbilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

coreAbilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
coreAbilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

coreAbilities.name: GUARDED HERO
coreAbilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

coreAbilities.name: CHAMPION
coreAbilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

coreAbilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
coreAbilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
coreAbilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

coreAbilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
coreAbilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

coreAbilities.name: RALLY
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
coreAbilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

coreAbilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
coreAbilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

coreAbilities.name: SACRED RITES
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
coreAbilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

coreAbilities.name: POWER THROUGH
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
coreAbilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

coreAbilities.name: MUSICIAN
coreAbilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

coreAbilities.name: UNBIND
coreAbilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
coreAbilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

coreAbilities.name: COVERING FIRE
coreAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
coreAbilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.
